ffmpeg.wasm JavaScript wrapper

ffmpeg-core.js and ffmpeg-core.wasm
These files are the single-thread build of @ffmpeg/core 0.12.6.
The WebAssembly binary contains FFmpeg and libx264. FFmpeg is licensed under
the GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 or later. libx264 is licensed
under the GNU General Public License version 2 or later. Because this build
links libx264, the combined core is distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later.
See LICENSE.GPL-2.0.txt.

ECRS loads these files only after the user asks to transcode a video that the
browser cannot decode. They are not loaded with the spreadsheet.
